caveats: Density norms use shared h=1 samples, not all native fine-grid cells; probe order is indicative.
Only two cases have time-refinement controls; precision_target_pass permits absent time controls.
Flux voxel faces move by h/2 between grids; instantaneous E/Q closure and sampled time integrals are separate.
Trapezoidal flux integrals use cadence 0.5; reducing evolution dt does not refine that quadrature.
Momentum closure after spatial residual subtraction tests temporal integration, not independently correct stress.
Phase contrasts have unequal initial E/Q and are not isolated force measurements.

selected_fields.scope: Static real-seeded 3D stationary search; no free evolution, Hessian, quantum stability or KEV activation.
selected_fields.caveat: Box check at coarse h; radii use discrete cumulative samples. Other charges lack fine-grid/box controls.

selected_fields.scope: Finite real-seeded search; curvature only on sampled localized branch, not global concavity.
